posts.text: 25. aug. · Endret I dag leverte SMG Swiss Marketplace (Vend peer) en solid rapport (H1 og Q2) som nok er forklaringen på Vends kursstigning i dag. AI er en stor fordel for markedslederne. Dette begynner markedet å ta inn over seg nå. For ca 1 år siden sto Vend kursen i 390 kr. Med de urealiserte verdiene i Adevinta så tenker jeg det er absolutt mulig for kursen å nå 300 kr YTD 2026 og 400 kr YTD 2027. Meglerhuset ABG skriver: SMG Swiss Marketplace (Vend peer): H1 sales CHF180m, +0.8% vs cons; adj. EBITDA CHF102m, +1.1% vs cons (and up 16% yoy). FY26 revenue growth guidance raised/narrowed to +11–12% vs prior +10–12% (cons at 11%). EBITDA margin guidance confirmed at 56–58% implying ’26 EBITDA of EUR 210m, +1.6% vs cons; capex improved to 7.5–8.5% of sales (vs previous 8-9%).  On AI; frames AI as a growth enabler—not a traffic risk.  Conversational search is live across all core platforms, improving discovery, listings, seller tools and agent workflows. The edge is proprietary inventory and intent data.  Our comment on AI; much of the same as from peers. Another solid report and Q2 has been a good quarter for marketplaces. Should be pos for sector Vis 1 kommentar til
